reason: The IDENTITY positive control failed only in the exact-oracle reconstruction path, so v1 candidate NOT-VALIDATED labels are not interpretable as symmetry failures.

rootCause.description: v1 reconstructed raw oracle nodes directly from canonical result stateRows.ruleState. Three terminal row snapshots have pending=[0,0] and only 63 represented seeds, while their frozen raw stateKey corresponds to the actual terminal raw state with pending=[1,0]. This makes even IDENTITY fail raw identity and corrupts retrograde reconstruction.

allowedCorrection.correctionPrinciple: Reconstruct the immutable oracle graph from its frozen nonterminal root under the production and independent guard-free Mtaji implementations, require exact equality to the immutable 8-state/7-edge stateSetSha256 and transitionSetSha256, and only then transform/solve that reconstructed raw graph.

interpretationBoundary: The v1 fresh zero-mismatch observations are retained only as invalidated-run diagnostics and are not formal positive findings. v2 must rerun all frozen candidates uniformly after identity-control validation of the corrected oracle harness.
